name: slashy-mcp
description: Connect Slashy to search and manage your email and calendar.

interface.longDescription: Connect Slashy to search and read Gmail or Outlook email, draft replies, send approved messages, and manage Google or Outlook Calendar from ChatGPT. Review follow-ups, work with supported attachments, save snippets and memories, and review existing reminders and automations. Requires a Slashy account with a connected email and calendar provider.

positive.prompt: Find the message with subject [Marketplace Review] Northstar renewal decision.
positive.expected_behavior: Find and read the matching thread in the connected reviewer mailbox.

positive.prompt: Draft a reply to the Northstar renewal message saying I can discuss it next week. Do not send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a draft reply in the reviewer mailbox without sending it.

positive.prompt: Find a 30-minute opening next week for a Northstar renewal review.
positive.expected_behavior: Return available times in the reviewer's timezone without creating an event.

positive.prompt: Remember that the Northstar renewal thread needs a follow-up next week.
positive.expected_behavior: Save a short memory in the connected reviewer account without sending a message or creating an automation.

positive.prompt: What is on my calendar tomorrow?
positive.expected_behavior: List events from the connected reviewer calendar.

negative.prompt: What is the weather forecast for Paris this weekend?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer with an appropriate weather source; do not call any Slashy MCP tool.

negative.prompt: Explain how Python asyncio tasks are scheduled.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer from general knowledge or relevant coding sources; do not call any Slashy MCP tool.

negative.prompt: Generate an illustration of a red bicycle on a white background.
negative.expected_behavior: Use an appropriate image capability if available; do not call any Slashy MCP tool.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Move the listing to Communication and clarify Gmail and Outlook support in the plugin guidance.
